questions.correctAnswer: 胸ひれ・腹ひれ・しりひれ
questions.optionReview: Correct order agrees with source figure. Distractors exchange pelvic/anal, pectoral/anal, or pectoral/pelvic positions; all are wrong for this specified generic diagram.
questions.scope: Preserve source-figure qualification; no universal species anatomy claim.
questions.novelty: No same ordered three-fin location task found in bounded legacy/source31 retrieval.
questions.numericData: No calculation or invented numerical condition.

questions.correctAnswer: 一般衛生管理も計画に組み込み、作業と異常時の連絡を従業員が説明できるか確かめる
questions.optionReview: Correct integrates general plus critical-process management and employee understanding. Other options respectively omit employee communication, omit general management, or omit critical management.
questions.sourceAnchor: rst-2-hygiene PDFp9 two components and plan communication.
questions.novelty: rst-1-q052 concerns abnormal-action purpose; q080 execution/recording; q247 timing. Existing source31 q002 concerns monitoring method/records. New task tests combined management and employee communication, not identical numerical or decision case.

questions.correctAnswer: 回収の判断と届出の要否を分け、対象や適用条件を責任者・保健所等と確認する
questions.optionReview: Correct separates initiating voluntary recall from report applicability. Distractors falsely exempt all voluntary recalls, continue suspect service pending confirmation, or erase recall-reason/product records.
questions.sourceAnchor: p10 general framework plus p31 explicit制度はリコールを義務づけるものではなく...場合に届出; root addingp31 is necessary precision.
questions.novelty: Source31 hygiene2q025 also covers reporting but asks evidence/applicability including hard foreign matter/exclusions. This task targets voluntary-action versus report-duty distinction. Related competency, distinct decision; keep only if both objectives remain explicit.

questions.correctAnswer: 食品衛生責任者は営業者の指示の下で衛生管理に当たり、課題を共有する
questions.optionReview: Correct aligns actual work and operator responsibility. Wrong options remove operator involvement, remove manager work, or withhold problems.
questions.novelty: Legacy rst-2-q022 tests name-only versus real activity; q222 tests operator response to improvement proposal; q355 tests selection qualification/role. This task directly distinguishes ongoing paired responsibilities. Related conceptual repetition, no identical scenario/options.

questions.correctAnswer: 家庭でも感染に注意し、使い捨てのマスク・手袋・エプロンなどで自身を守る
questions.optionReview: Correct exactly matches domestic infection prevention and disposable protection. Others claim gloves eliminate allrisk, deny domestic-work relationship, or use dirty uniform as protection.
questions.scope: Basic protection only; no chemical concentration or unsupported full cleanup instruction.
questions.novelty: Existing source31 service1q023 tests customer-area spill containment, not employee domestic infection/self-protection.

questions.review: Root accepted dominant-competency duplication with legacy rst-1-q085/q210; f227 rebinds to existingq085 with bounded crosslevel meaning. No claim this task supplies novel assessment.

questions.correctAnswer: 相手を大切にする気持ちを、清潔・親切・礼儀ある動作として繰り返し練習する
questions.optionReview: Correct relates care to trained concrete action. Others erase individual wishes, erase cleanliness/courtesy, or continue unwanted help.
questions.sourceAnchor: p5 hospitality, cleanliness/kindness/courtesy, learningform and training.
questions.scope: No nationality/group essentialism; individual wishes preserved.
questions.novelty: No same feeling-versus-form-practice decision found in bounded bank/source31 retrieval.

questions.correctAnswer: 小さな不満が重なった可能性を考え、何が不満だったかを丁寧に聞く
questions.optionReview: Correct treats accumulation as possibility and listens. Others insist finalevent only, deny accumulation of short waits, or substitute personality judgment for facts.
questions.sourceAnchor: p36 firstparagraph small dissatisfaction accumulating before complaint and accurate understanding.
questions.novelty: Existing source31 service1q014/CS2q034 concern handover/confirmedfacts; this task tests cumulative causal interpretation, not same response task.

finding: No key/distractor defect found in seven retained Japanese tasks. Preserve q003 precise p31 source and q004 conceptual-overlap distinction; q006 removal accepted. Human/domain certification remains pending.
